images.title: Zooming into 4.185
images.purpose: Show that each digit of 4.185 gives one zoom into a smaller gap, ending at the middle mark of 4.18 to 4.19.
images.composition: Three number lines stacked vertically, each shorter than the last, joined by grey zoom lines; ample white space.
exact_structure: Line 1: from 4 to 5, 10 equal parts; ends labelled 4 and 5; the part from 4.1 to 4.2 highlighted amber (#E69F00), labelled 4.1 and 4.2 below it.
Line 2: from 4.1 to 4.2, 10 equal parts, ends labelled 4.1 and 4.2; the part from 4.18 to 4.19 highlighted amber, labelled 4.18 and 4.19 below.
Line 3: from 4.18 to 4.19, 10 equal parts, ends labelled 4.18 and 4.19; the 5th mark after 4.18 is a reddish purple (#CC79A7) dot labelled 4.185.
Two pairs of grey (#6B7280) dashed zoom lines joining the highlighted part of each line to the full width of the next line below.
rejection: fewer or more than three lines
the purple dot is not on the middle (5th) mark of line 3
the highlighted parts do not match the digits 1 and 8
any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each digit tells which small gap to zoom into next.
images.description: Three stacked number lines zooming from 4 to 5, then 4.1 to 4.2, then 4.18 to 4.19, ending at 4.185.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Follow the dashed lines down and match each zoom to a digit.

image_decisions.why: The stack shows the digit by digit zoom that locates a decimal exactly.
